name: Hello Charlotte: Heaven's Gate
source:
[i]You're hidden behind the lines.
I reach out, deafened by silence.
As we mourn the Grasshopper's passing,
Heaven's gate opens.[/i]

This is a story set in a parallel universe with a focus on True Realm characters from Hello Charlotte series. Therefore, playing Hello Charlotte first is advised.

[From [url=https://etherane.itch.io/hg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]你隐藏在线条之后。
我伸出手，却被寂静震聋。
当我们哀悼蚱蜢之死时，
天堂之门开启。[/i]

这是一个平行宇宙中的故事，聚焦《你好夏洛特》系列的真实领域角色。因此，建议先游玩《你好夏洛特》。

[来源：[url=https://etherane.itch.io/hg]Itch.io[/url]]
